name: Voice-only example — no eye tracking, no chinrest
notes: An example, not a protocol anyone has run. It exists to show that a study
definition genuinely changes what happens: this one skips the chinrest and
the calibration grid entirely, and the capture page still requests the
microphone because `voice` is enabled. Copy it and change the disclosure
before using it for anything real.

disclosure.secondary_use: Recordings are analysed by the named team and are not shared outside it.
disclosure.contact: Replace with the investigator and the route to the ethics board.
